products.name: Paracetamol Advance Fast-Acting

products.sideEffects: Rare when taken as directed. Allergic reactions or liver toxicity if overdosed.

products.description: Prescription penicillin antibiotic combined with a beta-lactamase inhibitor for respiratory, ear, and sinus infections.

products.name: LipidCare Atorvastatin
products.description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) used to reduce LDL bad cholesterol and triglycerides, lowering risk of heart disease and stroke.
products.usageAdvice: Take one tablet once daily at the same time every evening, with or without food.
products.sideEffects: Muscle soreness, digestive issues, mild headache.

products.name: Glucovance Metformin XR
products.description: First-line oral anti-hyperglycemic agent for Type 2 Diabetes mellitus. Helps restore your body's proper response to insulin.
products.usageAdvice: Swallow whole with an evening meal. Do not crush or chew.

products.usageAdvice: Take 1 tablet once daily with water. Can be taken with or without food.

products.name: GastroShield Omeprazole
products.description: Proton Pump Inhibitor (PPI) that suppresses stomach acid production, treating heartburn, GERD, and gastric ulcers effectively.
products.usageAdvice: Take 1 capsule in the morning at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

messages.text: What is the dosage for fever?

For mild headache or fever, Paracetamol 500mg (1-2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours, max 4000mg/day) is our standard first recommendation. If you have inflammation or joint pain, Ibuprofen 400mg taken with meals works well. Do you have any prior stomach ulcer conditions?
